== Summary ==
Identified, in a group at Rokka: [[Kevin Jaap]], [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]], [[Lynden Pater]] (white tee, glasses; same face as [[:File:Lynden Pater.jpg]]), [[Chris Menzel]], [[Angelo Consoli]] (Obi-Wan Kenobi tee; same face as [[:File:Angelo Consoli 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg]]), [[Emil Wallin]] (olive Mandalorian-hunter tee, blonde bun), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), [[Tamás Papp]] (blue tee, sunglasses, white watch), and [[Enno Haede]] (his name is printed on his shirt). Remaining: a man in a black jacket with yellow piping (same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals quiz 1.jpg]]), and the man standing behind Kevin (same face as the pink shirt / Jack & Jones shirt in the weekend stills).

The 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK (2–4 June 2023), hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-03
* '''Camera date:''' 2023-06-03
* '''Identification:''' Identified, in a group at Rokka: [[Kevin Jaap]], [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]], [[Lynden Pater]] (white tee, glasses; same face as [[:File:Lynden Pater.jpg]]), [[Chris Menzel]], [[Angelo Consoli]] (Obi-Wan Kenobi tee; same face as [[:File:Angelo Consoli 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg]]), [[Emil Wallin]] (olive Mandalorian-hunter tee, blonde bun), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), [[Tamás Papp]] (blue tee, sunglasses, white watch), and [[Enno Haede]] (his name is printed on his shirt). Remaining: a man in a black jacket with yellow piping (same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals quiz 1.jpg]]), and the man standing behind Kevin (same face as the pink shirt / Jack & Jones shirt in the weekend stills).
